en.description:
Where do your tokens actually go? Hourly curve, click a bar for a per-minute breakdown, and model split at a glance. The same model can cost several times more at one relay than another - batch speed tests and per-brand latency/price comparison. Bills get a full check-up: unit price, cache, model switching. Fully local, costs no tokens.
